name: Glen shallow-ice outlet with nonlinear thickness-dependent discharge
description: Own one-cell rectangular fixed-slope/no-sliding specialization: q=2A/(n+2)*(rho*g*slope)^n*H^(n+2), n3, and dH/dt=accumulation-q/L. Geometry, thermal softness and accumulation are fixed, with no calving, elevation feedback or spatial solution. Coefficient has unitsm^-4/year and was chosen for a150m equilibrium, not fitted to Greenland. Distinct from existing temperature-driven ice-volume balance. All numerical parameters, initial values, horizon and solver settings are illustrative teaching choices; not fitted to a field site. Signed net-rate flows encode state equations, not material transport claims. No numerical clipping or arbitrary domain clamps.
reference: Glen(1955), The creep of polycrystalline ice; first-party OGGM shallow-ice formulation https://docs.oggm.org/en/v1.5.1/ice-dynamics.html Eqs volume conservation,ud,fd,driving stress.
